title: Assembly Line Diagram — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Feed and Spark
scenes.purpose: Raw idea enters from the left and is stamped into a concept at station 01 SPARK.
visuals: Wide side view: three labelled stations above one conveyor
Ring part rides in; station header turns active blue; ram stamps; flash ring; bulb appears; tag 'raw idea' becomes 'concept'

beats.development: Frame opens settled with headline and stations; the raw-idea ring feeds right onto station 01 while rollers turn.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system
LINE A · ONE PART · THREE HAND-OFFS

beats.development: Header goes active blue, ram stamps down, flash ring bursts, ring becomes a bulb (concept); header returns to neutral.

scenes.title: Hand-off and Shape
scenes.purpose: Concept travels to 02 SHAPE; a mould shell closes over it and lifts to reveal a module.
visuals: Ledger arrow raw idea → concept draws, head appears at its end
Mould shell descends, hides swap, lifts revealing pinned square module

beats.development: Part travels 300→640; ledger shaft 1 draws and 'concept' label appears under the line.
Header 02 active; mould closes, part becomes module, mould lifts; tag becomes 'module'.

scenes.title: Connect and Release
scenes.purpose: Module is probed at 03 CONNECT into a linked three-node system and released to the right.
visuals: Three-pin probe touches; nodes pop and edges draw in active blue
Exit right; ledger arrow module → system; bold blue 'system'

beats.development: Part travels 640→980; ledger shaft 2 draws, 'module' label appears.
Header 03 active; probe descends; module becomes a connected triangle of nodes; tag becomes 'system'.
System exits right to x=1140; ledger shaft 3 and bold 'system' complete by 2.54; full diagram holds settled.

findings: Each station has separate travel (hand-off) and dwell (transformation) beats of ~0.3 s each.
All motion ends by 2.54 s; composition settled before 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 0.46 s final hold so the complete traced chain raw idea → concept → module → system can be read.
